track.title: Homayun: Shushtari and Mansuri
track.notes: Open: the suite's finalis is unsettled: votes split between G and the 4th above it, and Daramad I votes the 4th. Vote kept.

progression.narrative: The performance opens on D4 and dwells most on C in Shushtari and Mansuri. The line peaks at Dk4 (268.2 Hz) at 0:27.5. It closes on B3, not the tonic (C4 → C4 → C4 → G3 → C4 → B3).
